name: Utah Puzzling for Awareness V Favorites 2026
information: The proceeds of this event will be donated to Friends of Giant Steps, a program that supports preschool programs for students with Autism Spectrum Disorder in Utah Valley This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at UVU. Membership is open to both UVU and non-UVU students. For more details, visit the [Cubing Club at UVU tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahPuzzlingforAwarenessV2026#59124-cubing-club-at-uvu). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Go to our [website](utahcubing.org) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
